With S_lambda, V^beta_lambda, W^delta_lambda, H(D_n)_{lambda,m}, W^n_{lambda,m} as in Poulain d'Andecy-Walker, consider a cyclotomic datum whose quiver vertex set contains +-1, in particular Situation (a) lambda=1 (connected quiver stable under i|->i^{-1} with fixed points). For a finite exact block e_delta H(D_n)_{lambda,m} ≅ W^delta_{lambda,m} (Theorem 5.8/Corollary 5.9): Do the graded decomposition numbers d_{mu,nu}(v) in N[v,v^{-1}] of W^delta_{lambda,m} coincide with the coefficients of the Kashiwara-Miemietz-Enomoto symmetric-crystal upper global basis {G^up(b)} of the B_theta(g)-module V^theta suitably extended to allow theta-fixed vertices +-1 (without hypothesis theta(i)!=i), with E_i,F_i acting by restriction/induction and tilde E_i,tilde F_i matching socle/head crystal operators on graded simples, so that graded simples biject with the extended crystal B^theta and ungraded decomposition numbers are the v=1 specializations?
